title: DACH1 attenuated PA-induced renal tubular injury through TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway.
authors: Lin, J; Li, B; Xu, Q; Liu, Y S; Kang, Y L; Wang, X; Wang, Y; Lei, Y; Bai, Y L; Li, X M; Zhou, J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DACH1在棕榈酸诱导肾小管损伤中的保护作用，涉及分子对接但核心为细胞与信号通路实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Palmitic acid (PA), the major saturated fatty acid in the blood, often induces the initiation and progression of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). However, the underlying mechanism remains unclear. DACH1 is an important regulator of kidney functions. Herein, we investigated the roles of DACH1 in PA-induced kidney injury. METHODS: Clinical data from the NHANES database were subjected to analyse the association between serum PA (sPA), blood glucose and kidney function. Molecular docking of PA was performed with DACH1. Immunohistochemistry, cell viability, annexin V/7-AAD double staining, TUNEL assay, immunofluorescent staining, autophagic flux analysis, qRT-PCR and western blot were performed. RESULTS: Clinical data confirmed that sPA was increased significantly in the pathoglycemia individuals compared with controls and correlated negatively with renal function. Our findings suggested that PA could dock with DACH1. DACH1 enhances cell viability by inhibiting apoptosis and attenuating autophagy blockage induced by PA. Furthermore, the results demonstrated that DACH1 ameliorated inflammation and fibrosis through TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta/Smad signalling pathway in PA-treated renal tubular epithelial cell line (HK-2). CONCLUSIONS: This study proved that sPA presents a risk factor for kidney injuries and DACH1 might serve as a protective target against renal function deterioration in diabetic patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：棕榈酸（PA）是血液中的主要饱和脂肪酸，常诱导糖尿病肾病（DKD）的发生和进展。然而，其潜在机制尚不清楚。DACH1是肾脏功能的重要调节因子。在此，我们研究了DACH1在PA诱导的肾损伤中的作用。方法：对NHANES数据库的临床数据进行分析，以评估血清PA（sPA）、血糖与肾功能之间的关联。对PA与DACH1进行了分子对接。进行了免疫组织化学、细胞活力、膜联蛋白V/7-AAD双染色、TUNEL检测、免疫荧光染色、自噬流分析、qRT-PCR和蛋白质印迹实验。结果：临床数据证实，与对照组相比，血糖异常个体的sPA显著升高，并与肾功能呈负相关。我们的发现表明，PA可与DACH1对接。DACH1通过抑制凋亡和减轻PA诱导的自噬阻断来增强细胞活力。此外，结果表明，在PA处理的肾小管上皮细胞系（HK-2）中，DACH1通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB和TGF-beta/Smad信号通路改善炎症和纤维化。结论：本研究证明sPA是肾损伤的风险因素，DACH1可能作为糖尿病患者肾功能恶化的保护性靶点。
